lead.en: Compare estimated token costs using rates and usage provided by your application.
lead.zh: 根据应用提供的费率和用量比较 token 费用估算。

rule.en: All prices and usage are supplied by the host. Prices are USD per million tokens; the estimate is not a bill. Negative, non-finite or overflowing values return no estimate. Sample prices are explicitly labelled.
rule.zh: 全部价格和用量由宿主提供。价格单位为每百万 token 美元；结果为估算而非账单。负数、非有限值或溢出不会产生金额。样例价格会明确标注。

api.en: set_models updates rates; set_usage updates workload; reset restores the initial workload. Subscribe to LlmCostEvent for usage and selection changes. compute_llm_cost is a pure function returning Option<LlmCost>. Four sliders edit workload and cache hit rate; host values outside slider ranges still calculate exactly until edited.
api.zh: set_models 更新价格，set_usage 更新用量，重置恢复初始用量；订阅 LlmCostEvent 接收用量和选择变化。compute_llm_cost 是返回 Option<LlmCost> 的纯函数。四个滑块可调整用量与缓存命中率，超出滑块范围的宿主数据在编辑前仍按原值计算。

motion.en: Ranks and bars currently update immediately. Reordering springs, rolling totals, loading and error integration, and real desktop, Web, touch and screen-reader acceptance remain pending.
motion.zh: 排名和色条目前即时更新；排序弹簧、数字滚动、加载和错误接入，以及桌面、网页、触屏和读屏实测仍待完成。
